Patient: There’s been noticeable irritation and redness, but no sores or unusual discharge that I can see. The itching feels worse at times—especially after friction—and it seems to flare after using scented soaps or pads.
Have you noticed any changes in the appearance of

Doctor: Have you noticed any changes in the appearance of the vulvar skin—such as white patches, thickened skin, or areas that look different—or any pain when you urinate? Patient: I haven’t noticed any white patches or sores, but the area feels very tender and inflamed, and it does burn with friction; I haven’t had pain with urination.

Patient: I’m 60 years old, and I went through menopause about 8 years ago. I haven’t had any major urinary symptoms, just the vulvar itching and burning with friction and sex.
